Conclusion: The test `test_getitem_ndarray_3d` checks whether an Indexer object raises a ValueError when trying to index with a multidimensional key. However, the test fails because the Indexer object does not raise any error when passed a 3-dimensional array (`nd3`). This is likely due to the implementation of `__getitem__` methods in some classes within `pandas.core.indexes.numeric`, which might not correctly handle multidimensional keys.

Potential locations for fixing this issue:

pandas.core.indexes.extension.ExtensionIndex.__getitem__
pandas.core.indexes.range.RangeIndex.__getitem__
pandas.core.indexes.frozen.FrozenList.__getitem__
pandas.core.indexes.base.Index.__getitem__
```
